ruleset.name: nitpicker
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD categories for main and test sources.

rule.message: Field {0} has the same name as a method. Rename one of them; a method named exactly like its field with at most one parameter (an accessor, a fluent setter or builder step) is allowed. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/AvoidFieldNameMatchingMethodName in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static' and pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')]/VariableDeclarator/VariableId [some $method in ../../..[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody]/MethodDeclaration satisfies lower-case(@Name) = lower-case($method/@Name) and not(@Name = $method/@Name and $method/FormalParameters[@Size < 2])]

rule.message: Use a named constant instead of this literal in the condition (-1, 0, 1 and 2 are allowed). If it is not a magic number, add an exception for pmd/AvoidLiteralsInIfCondition in nitpicker.config.json.
Assign first, then use the variable. An assignment in a while condition is allowed. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/AssignmentInOperand in nitpicker.config.json.

Pass values as placeholders (LOG.debug("user '{'}", user)) and compute nothing in the arguments; guard the call with isDebugEnabled() only when an argument must be computed. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/GuardLogStatement in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: ./MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]] [not(ArgumentList/*[position() > 1][not( self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression or self::StringLiteral or self::NumericLiteral or self::BooleanLiteral or self::CharLiteral or self::NullLiteral or (self::MethodCall[ArgumentList[@Size = 0]] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ThisExpression]]))])]

rule.name: LogStringConcatenation
rule.message: Pass values as placeholders (LOG.info("user '{'}", user); '{'0} in System.Logger and java.util.logging), not a message built with + or String.format. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/LogStringConcatenation in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('info', 'warn', 'error', 'log', 'config', 'warning', 'severe')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log')]] /ArgumentList/(*[1] | *[1][not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String'))]/following-sibling::*[1]) [(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'] and not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())) or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('format', 'formatted')]]

rule.name: GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode
rule.message: JaCoCo and PIT skip code annotated @Generated, so this is not measured. Remove the annotation from hand-written code. If this file is generated, add an exception for pmd/GeneratedOnHandWrittenCode in nitpicker.config.json.
